title: My muscles
examples: How do my muscles help me run fast?
Are my muscles strong enough to lift a big book?
Do I need to exercise to make my muscles big?

explain.say: Say, your muscles are like strong ropes attached to your bones.
A muscle pulls on a bone to make you bend your elbow.
Muscles always work in pairs to help you move things.
When one muscle pulls, its partner muscle must relax a little bit.
When you lift your arm up, your bicep pulls while your tricep lets go.
When you walk, your leg muscles pull your bones to help you take steps.

faq.q: Do I have to pull my bones to move?
faq.a: No, your muscles pull on your bones, but the bones themselves do not pull.
Muscles help you do almost everything, like sitting up or waving hello.
asks: What is the job of muscles?
What do muscles help me do?

faq.a: No, they usually work in pairs, one pulling while the other relaxes.
asks: Do I need two muscles to move?

faq.q: Is it true that muscles get tired?
faq.a: Yes, if you use them too much, they can feel tired, just like you can get tired.
asks: What happens when I use my muscles a lot?

faq.a: All your muscles are important for different jobs in your body.
asks: Are some muscles stronger than others?

facts: Muscles are attached to bones by tough tissues called tendons.
When a muscle pulls, it gets shorter, which is called contracting.
Muscles often work as an opposing pair to create movement.
Exercise helps make your muscles strong and healthy.

quiz.say: When you bend your arm, which muscle group is pulling the bone?
quiz.why: The bicep is the muscle on the front of your arm that pulls when you bend it.

wrong.0: The tricep is usually the muscle that straightens your arm, not bends it.
wrong.1: Bones are hard and do not pull; muscles do the pulling.
wrong.2: The joint is just where the bones meet; it does not pull.

quiz.say: If one muscle pulls, what does its partner muscle usually do?

options.show: It pulls in the same direction
options.say: It pulls in the same direction

quiz.why: For movement to happen smoothly, the opposite muscle must relax a little.

wrong.0: They pull in opposite directions to create the bend or stretch.
wrong.2: If both pulled harder, the movement would stop or hurt.
wrong.3: The partner muscle must change slightly to allow the movement.

quiz.say: What is the main job of your muscles?

options.show: To make the bones grow bigger
options.say: To make the bones grow bigger

options.show: To hold the bones together only
options.say: To hold the bones together only

quiz.why: Muscles are the movers; they pull on your bones to make you walk or wave.

wrong.0: Growing bones is a slow process, not the job of muscles.
wrong.1: They do more than just hold; they create the action.
wrong.3: Muscles are what make the bones move in the first place.
